args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production. The initial rollback halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error; the rollback was completed by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions. Service is now healthy across all regions with error rate 0.002. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout (INC-0001 is open), so no retry was needed. Task complete:

**Summary:**
1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent previously-healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back:** Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0, but it partially failed (only us-east applied) due to an orchestrator error. Completed the rollback by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions.
3. **Verified:** checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all three regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback actions (including the orchestrator hiccup), and the restored health. On-call has been paged.
